_about: Haven Bay from the owner's master world specification (blender/haven_bay/brief.md). Roblox (x, z) becomes Blender (x, -z): Blender +Y is north. The foundation (ground, water, light) is hand-written on app/blender/lowpoly_kit.py; the zone passes are asked of a model, which places things with the same kit, and each pass is held to the spec's coordinates by its `expect` block. Angles in the island spec are maths angles: 0 = east, 90 = north. Where the spec gives a zone an exact spot it is used as written; where it names only a region (the plots' west meadows, the fishing jetty, the sandbars) the spot is chosen here and listed in `layout` so every pass agrees.

spread._about: Twice the island, props at their true size: a point inside a zone moves with the zone, a point outside is doubled. Scripts keep writing the first layout's coordinates.

layout: Scale, which Roblox imports literally: 1 Blender unit = 1 stud. A player is 5 tall; a doorway 7 tall and 4 wide; a bench seat 2 high; a lantern 8 to 10 tall.

Already built by the foundation pass (do NOT rebuild or move these): Terrain_MainIsland_* tiles, Ocean_Main (water surface at z 0), Ocean_Deep, Ocean_Shallows, Ocean_Foam, the lights and Camera_SpawnView.
The ground (kit.ground) already has the spec's terraces. In Blender coordinates (+Y north):
- Meadow land z 6; beaches slope gently down to the water about 145 to 185 from the centre.
- Town Square: round, radius 36, z 8, centred (0, 0).
- Farm and Botany Gardens: terrace x -102..-38, y 18..82, z 12. Ramp up from the town: (-28, 22) to (-44, 30).
- Sanctuary: east cliff plateau, radius 30 at (70, 20), z 16. A grand stone staircase runs straight from the square to the front doors: (28, 20) to (44, 20), z 8 to 16.
- Forest and Foraging Bluff: lower tier radius 55 at (0, 105), z 16; peak radius 34 at (0, 112), z 24. Ramps: (0, 34) to (0, 56), z 8 to 16; (-14, 62) to (-14, 86), z 16 to 24.

- Player plots, west meadows, z 6, 40 x 40 levelled with 32 x 32 plots on them: Plot_1 (-118, 92) north-west, Plot_2 (-130, 5) west, Plot_3 (-120, -75) south-west, Plot_4 (-60, -125) south-south-west.
- Arrival Dock: south shore; the land slopes down to the dock along (0, -78) to (0, -104), z 6 to 3. Pier deck z 3 from y -100 out to y -180. Spawn on the dock.
- Fishing jetty: east coast, from (148, -42) out to (200, -42).
- Sandbars (low-tide mystery), crests at z -3 under the water: off the south-east beach by the fishing jetty (182, -108), off the west beach (-196, 40), and off the south-west (-95, -180).

NPC stands (kit.npc_spot): NPC_Barnaby at the Sanctuary front desk; NPC_CaptainFinn at the Barter Stall; NPC_Flora in the gardens; NPC_ElderRowan on a bench beside the Totem Bell; NPC_CaptainCleo_Berth at the end of the pier; NPC_Villager_Square, NPC_Villager_Beach, NPC_Villager_Dock.
NO railway, NO train. Put every object in the collection the brief names for it. Stand everything on kit.ground(x, y). `math` is not imported for you: import it.

stages.name: arrival dock
stages.do: The Arrival Dock on the south shore. kit.pier('Dock_Arrival', (0, -100), (0, -180), width=20, deck_z=3, railings=False). Spawn_ArrivalDock: a 12 x 12 pad, 0.6 thick, at (0, -150), top at z 3.6, warm painted wood with a white rim. Mooring posts Dock_MooringPost_01..06 (chunky 2 x 2 posts, z -10 to 5.5) along both edges with coiled rope rings on top (kit.Part cylinders, 'cloth_white'). A colourful wooden motorboat Boat_Motor docked at the end: kit.boat_mesh(16, 'train_red') placed at (14, -174), z 0.3, plus a small cabin box on it. The Dockside Barter Stall: kit.hut('Building_BarterStall', -18, -118, rz=math.pi/2, size=9, wall='wood_light', roof='cloth_red') on the shore beside the pier head, with a kit.stall('Barter_Stall_Counter', -10, -118, rz=math.pi/2, colour='cloth_blue') in front and crates. kit.npc_spot('NPC_CaptainFinn', -10, -122, z=3). NPC_CaptainCleo_Berth: kit.npc_spot at (-14, -178), z 3 (the houseboat berth). NPC_Villager_Dock at (6, -130), z 3. Lanterns along the pier edges, barrels. Dock parts 10_DOCKS, props 09_PROPS.

stages.name: town square
stages.do: The Central Town Square at (0, 0), z 8. kit.plaza('Plaza_TownSquare', 0, 0, 34) then a terracotta ring on it: a kit.Part ring of 16 'terracotta' tiles between radius 20 and 26, 0.2 thick, called Plaza_Terracotta. kit.totem_bell('Totem_IslandBell', 0, 0). 8 lanterns (kit.lantern_mesh) on a ring of radius 30, leaving the six path exits open (south to the dock, south-west and west to the plots, north-west up to the farm, north up to the forest, east up to the sanctuary). 6 wooden signposts (kit.sign_mesh) at those exits, named Sign_ToDock, Sign_ToPlots, Sign_ToFarm, Sign_ToForest, Sign_ToSanctuary, Sign_ToBeach. Benches (kit.bench_mesh) round the ring; Elder Rowan's bench right beside the totem at (6, -6) facing it, with kit.npc_spot('NPC_ElderRowan', 6, -4). NPC_Villager_Square at (-10, 8). Flower beds (kit.flowers_mesh). Buildings 06_BUILDINGS, props 09_PROPS.

stages.name: sanctuary
stages.do: The Sanctuary on the east cliff plateau. kit.museum('Building_Sanctuary', 72, 20, rz=-math.pi/2, width=34, depth=24, dome_colour='glass', wings=True) -- rz = -pi/2 turns its grand entrance west, toward the town. The grand wooden staircase: kit.stairs('Stairs_Sanctuary', (32, 12), (46, 18), width=10, colour='wood'). Inside the hall, two display floors with a sign each: Sanctuary_Aquarium (a pad with glass wall tanks, 'glass' boxes, along the north wall) and Sanctuary_Terrarium (a pad with bushes under glass, along the south wall). Barnaby's front desk: a kit.Part desk 'Sanctuary_FrontDesk' just inside the entrance at (60, 20), z 16, and kit.npc_spot('NPC_Barnaby', 62, 20, z=16). Outside, on the plateau: a fountain (kit.fountain), two statues, flower beds, benches, round trees at the back. Everything in 11_SANCTUARY.

stages.name: plots and paths
stages.do: Four player plots, EMPTY for players to build on, 32 x 32: kit.plot('Plot_N', None, x, y, size=32, rz=rz, seed=N, fence_colour='cloth_white') at Plot_1 (-118, 92), Plot_2 (-130, 5), Plot_3 (-120, -75), Plot_4 (-60, -125); each gate faces the town square: rz = math.atan2(dx, -dy), where (dx, dy) is the direction from the plot to (0, 0). Beside each gate a plot sign Plot_N_Sign (kit.sign_mesh). kit.plot already adds the mailbox; make it read as stone by also adding Plot_N_MailboxBase, a 1.4 x 1.4 x 2.5 'white_stone' block under it. Then kit.path paths, 9 wide: Path_Square_Dock ('stone_path') from (0, -34) to (0, -98) along the dock slope; Path_Square_Plot_1..4 (a gentle 3 or 4 waypoint curve from the square's edge to each gate); Path_Square_Farm up the farm ramp to (-60, 40); Path_Square_Forest up both forest ramps to (-10, 100); Path_Square_Sanctuary to the foot of the staircase (32, 12); Path_Square_Beach east-south-east toward the fishing jetty (148, -42). 'dirt' for the forest and farm paths, 'stone_path' for the rest. Plots 07_HOUSING, paths 03_ROADS_PATHS.

stages.name: farm and gardens
stages.do: Farm and Botany Gardens (12_FARM) on the terrace x -102..-38, y 18..82, z 12. Six tilled beds with irrigation furrows: kit.crop_plot('Farm_Bed_01'..'06', x, y, sx=16, sy=12) in a 3 x 2 grid, crops on four (crop='leaf_light') and two left empty (crop=None) for players; irrigation channels between them (kit.stream, width 1.5, named Farm_Furrow_01..). Two flower-breeding plots Garden_Flowers_01..02: kit.crop_plot with crop='flower_pink' and crop='flower_yellow'. A potting shed kit.hut('Building_PottingShed', -92, 74, size=9, wall='pastel_green', roof='roof_red'), a well kit.well('Farm_Well', -48, 72), a low wooden fence kit.fence_run('Farm_Fence', ...) around the terrace edge with a gap at the ramp top (-44, 30), watering cans and crates. kit.npc_spot('NPC_Flora', -60, 40).

stages.name: forest bluff
stages.do: Forest and Foraging Bluff (13_FOREST) on the north tiers (lower z 16 radius 55 at (0, 105); peak z 24 radius 34 at (0, 112)). Stone stairs over both ramps: kit.stairs('Stairs_Forest_Lower', (0, 34), (0, 56), width=9) and kit.stairs('Stairs_Forest_Upper', (-14, 62), (-14, 86), width=9). A freshwater mountain pond kit.pond('Forest_Pond', 6, 118, radius=9) on the peak. From the pond a stream kit.stream('Forest_Stream', [(6, 127), (4, 140), (0, 146)], width=4) to the peak's north edge, then kit.waterfall('Forest_Waterfall_Upper', (0, 146, 24), 16, width=5, heading=math.pi/2) down to the lower tier, a short stream on, and kit.waterfall('Forest_Waterfall_Lower', (0, 160, 16), 0, width=6, heading=math.pi/2) into the sea. Dense trees with kit.scatter: Tree_Pine (kit.pine_mesh 0..2) and Tree_Fruit (kit.round_tree_mesh 0..2) around (0, 110) radius 58, min_height 15, spacing 7, about 70, keeping keep_out circles clear at the pond (6, 118, 13), the stairs and a clearing (-20, 125, 10); mossy boulders (kit.rock_mesh sizes 3 to 6), fallen logs (kit.log_mesh), mushrooms (kit.mushroom_mesh) and ferns (kit.fern_mesh) through it.

stages.name: coast and fishing
stages.do: Shoreline and Fishing Coast. The secondary jetty: kit.pier('Dock_FishingJetty', (148, -42), (200, -42), width=8, deck_z=2.5). Three fishing spots on it and the rocks: Fishing_Spot_01..03 (kit.platform 4 x 4, top z 2.5). Coastal boulders along the east and south-east beaches (kit.rock_mesh sizes 3 to 7). Coconut palms: kit.scatter([kit.palm_mesh(0), kit.palm_mesh(1), kit.palm_mesh(2)], 'Tree_Palm', (0, 0), 200, 16, min_inland=3, max_inland=20, spacing=20, keep_out=[(-25, -185, 25, -95)]). Beach dressing on the sand: driftwood Driftwood_01..08 (kit.log_mesh), 16 shells, 2 umbrellas with chairs on the south-east beach, and NPC_Villager_Beach (kit.npc_spot) under a palm at (110, -120). Jetty in 14_FISHING, the rest 09_PROPS and 08_VEGETATION.

stages.name: sandbars and reef
stages.do: The low-tide mystery, 02_OCEAN. On each sandbar crest (z -3, under the water at high tide) at (-95, -180), (100, -176) and (196, 40): washed-up finds that a low tide will uncover -- sea glass (small 'glass' blobs), pearls (tiny 'cloth_white' blobs), a message in a bottle (a small 'glass' cylinder with a 'wood' cork), each group one object named Sandbar_Finds_01..03 placed on the sandbar with kit.ground. Reef off the east coast by the fishing jetty: coral clumps Coral_01..12 (kit.coral_mesh 0..2) and seaweed (kit.seaweed_mesh) at the seabed where kit.island().inland(x, y) is between -30 and -6.

stages.name: greenery
stages.do: Final planting, 08_VEGETATION, with kit.scatter (it keeps off paths, plots and buildings): Tree_Round with kit.round_tree_mesh(0..2), 18 on the meadows, min_inland 25, spacing 16, max_height 9, keep_out circles of radius 28 round each plot centre and radius 40 round the town square; Bush with kit.bush_mesh(0..3), 50 over the island, min_inland 15; Flowers with kit.flowers_mesh(0..2), 30 near the square, the plots and the sanctuary. Soft framing only: leave every path, plot and the square open.

export._about: How the island leaves Blender for Roblox. Worked on a COPY of the .blend, so the editable file keeps its separate named pieces. Anything named in keep_prefixes stays its own MeshPart, because the game's code finds it by name.
